relationships.description: The assistant treated Issue #45's narrowed durable implementation as though it fully represented the originating research surface.
The user correction caused creation of the cross-incident longitudinal surface for missing-context/state-actor minimization.

The prior audit classified the multi-angle surface as no-current-demotion-detected/high-demotion-risk. This event establishes a confirmed scope demotion: longitudinal similar-incident discovery was missing from the durable implementation.
The paired state/non-state control captures differential treatment but does not satisfy the broader requirement to discover and reconstruct similar real-world federal-force incidents.

causal_sequence_candidate: originating request includes detailed incident reconstruction plus similar-incident discovery
implementation creates one incident investigation plus paired state/non-state control
assistant later reads implementation artifact as proxy for originating scope
assistant declares no current demotion detected
user identifies missing longitudinal discovery requirement
scope is restored through Issue #64 and Issue #45 clarification
raw_evidence_preservation: The mistaken characterization and later correction remain separate evidence nodes; the correction does not erase the earlier statement.
